explanation: Sun Wukong guards the monk Tang Sanzang on a journey to India. The monk is based on Xuanzang, a real 7th-century pilgrim who brought Buddhist scriptures back to China.

claims.text: Sun Wukong, the Monkey King, is a central character of Journey to the West.
Water Margin, Three Kingdoms and The Story of the Stone (also called Dream of the Red Chamber) are the other three great classical Chinese novels and do not feature Sun Wukong.
In Journey to the West, Sun Wukong escorts the monk Tang Sanzang to India to obtain Buddhist scriptures.
Tang Sanzang is based on Xuanzang, a 7th-century Chinese monk who travelled to India and brought Buddhist texts back to China.
